podcast.title: Catalog Acquisition Company
podcast.body: Primary Wave was mentioned as one of the companies involved in the "gold rush" for artists' music catalogs in the late 2010s. These companies acquired music rights for long-term lucrative propositions, offering artists upfront financial security and tax advantages. "They had names like Primary Wave, Hypnosis Song Fund, Roundheal, Concord, and Half a Does Another's."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
srcs.episode: The 100 Greatest Rock Moments of the Millennium So Far - Part 1: (100-91)

podcast.title: Music Catalog Acquisition Firm (mid-2010s)
podcast.body: One of a group of well-financed companies that have been actively buying up artists' music publishing rights since the mid-2010s, recognizing music as a valuable long-term investment. "There are companies like Primary Wave, Round Hill, Concord, and Hypnosis. They're all doing the same thing."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music

podcast.title: Song Catalog Acquisition Company
podcast.body: Primary Wave is listed among the companies that are actively buying up the rights to song catalogs from musicians. Their business model relies on generating future royalties from these acquired assets over an extended period.

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
srcs.episode: The Concept of Selling Out: Part 2
